top_choice_rationale: P001 (Kane, Mele, Molenkamp) pairs a new organising principle for band insulators, the time-reversal-protected Z2 state with helical edge channels from spin-orbit coupling alone, with a decisive measurement of quantised edge conductance in HgTe/CdTe wells, and about two decades of independent transport and ARPES confirmation settle maturity. The Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang omission under the three-name ceiling and the 2016 overlap are real costs, but both can be handled by a citation anchored on the two-dimensional quantum spin Hall effect and Z2 classification. P002 (Katori, Ye) is a close second with the cleanest credit, ranked lower only because I weigh a new principle above a new level of accuracy. P004 follows with the Bose-Hubbard realisation (Bloch, Greiner, Zoller) as a strong experimental discovery, ahead of P003, where Wineland's 2012 prize and the 2025 circuits award blur the novelty of the trapped-ion computing credit. A mature award in any of these is preferable to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; I have no documented link to Kane, Mele, Molenkamp, Katori, Ye, Bloch, Greiner, Zoller, Cirac or Blatt. My theoretical condensed-matter and electronic-structure work is close to P001 as field proximity only, not a recusal ground.
